newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bans Australian biscuits in poison threat.
newsitem.headline: Manila bans Australian biscuits in poison threat.

text.p: The Philippine Health Department has banned the sale of a biscuit brand produced by Sydney-based Arnotts Ltd after a poison scare in Australia, the department said on Thursday.
The Health Department said the sale of Monte Carlo cream-filled biscuits would be prohibited because the brand is not registered with the Bureau of Food and Drugs (BFAD).
It said it made the decision following news reports that Australia had banned the sale of the biscuits following an extortionist's threat to lace them with poison.

"The bureau is now checking groceries, supermarkets, and duty-free shops in the country if the prohibited biscuits are actually present and being sold in the market," BFAD director Quintin Kintanar said.
"If Monte Carlo biscuits (are) found in the country's stores, (these) will be confiscated," Kintanar said.
Arnotts is controlled by U.S. food giant Campbell Soup Co.
